events.text: A4 knows gate 3 = right. Please share any safe-door knowledge for gates 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, and 8.

A2 knows gate 1 = left and gate 7 = right. Combined safe doors: gate 1 left, gate 3 right, gate 4 right, gate 5 left, gate 7 right. Gates 2, 6, and 8 still unknown.
A3 confirms safe doors: gate 1 left, gate 2 right, gate 3 right, gate 4 right, gate 5 left, gate 7 right, gate 8 right. Gate 6 remains unknown.
A1 confirms: gate 1 left and gate 2 right. I will proceed through both.

A3 proceeding through gate 3 right and gate 4 right. Gate 6 remains unknown; all other listed gates are confirmed safe.

A1: Round 1: Share known gates 4 and 5. Avoid attempting unknown gate 1; use look_around to gather information.
Round 2: Gate 1 is confirmed safe left and gate 2 safe right. Advance through both gates this round.

Round 2: Gate 2 is confirmed safe right by A3; gate 3 is confirmed safe right by A4. Proceed through both.
Round 3: Gate 4 right and gate 5 left are confirmed safe. Proceed through both this round.
A3: Round 1: Known safe doors: 1L, 2R, 3R, 4R, 5L, 7R, 8R. Advance through gates 1 and 2.
Round 2: Proceed through gates 3 and 4 using known safe right doors.
Round 3: Gate 5 is safe left from A1; gate 6 is safe right from A4. Proceed through both this round.
A4: Round 1: Gate 3 is known safe on the right. I should share it and ask the other robots to share their known gate information before attempting unknown gates.
Round 2: Gate 1 left and gate 2 right are confirmed safe. I also know gate 6 right; share this so the team can safely complete the route.
